description:
We are a Singapore-based corporate events company that runs lunchtime talks, wellness sessions, and workshops for large organisations. We work with HR and L&D teams across government agencies, MNCs, and SMEs.

We are hiring a Lady remote Client Briefing Specialist to run our introductory video meetings with prospective corporate clients. You will be the first live point of contact after an enquiry comes in: a warm, polished 20–30 minute Zoom call where you introduce our company, walk the client through our offerings, understand their needs, and guide them toward booking a session. Excellent spoken English, clear and natural on video calls

Prior experience in B2B sales, client-facing calls, account management, or telesales (corporate clients preferred)

Strong cultural fluency with the Singapore corporate environment — comfortable speaking with Singaporean HR and management professionals

Confident, warm, and persuasive without being pushy

Reliable, punctual, and able to work Singapore business hours

Comfortable presenting from a prepared structure and improving with coaching



Nice to have



Background in events, corporate training, wellness, or professional services

Details



Fully remote

Singapore business hours (SGT)

[State your structure: monthly retainer, or retainer plus a per-booking incentive — see note below]

In your application, tell us in 4–5 sentences about a time you persuaded a hesitant client to say yes. At the top of your reply, write the word "Suntec" so we know you read this in full. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short live mock briefing over Zoom.

title: Outbound Sales Development Representative (Managed IT & Cybersecurity)
description:
About Frost Tech

Frost Tech is a Las Vegas-based Managed IT Services company serving small and mid-size businesses across Nevada and beyond. We’ve built a reputation on relationships — our client retention over four years is nearly perfect, and we intend to keep it that way as we scale.

We’re not a generic MSP. We run a purpose-built tech stack including Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, SentinelOne MDR, and the Frost Wall — our own proprietary white-labeled firewall solution. We are a certified Microsoft partner and backed by TD Synnex.

We’re looking for a driven, professional SDR to build our pipeline from the ground up. You’ll work directly with our founder — a veteran with over $10 million in personal sales — who will close every deal you bring in.



What You’ll Do

Your job is simple: find the right companies, reach the right people, and book qualified meetings. That’s it.

Daily responsibilities:

 • Research and build targeted prospect lists of Las Vegas-area businesses

 • Identify decision-makers via LinkedIn, Apollo, and similar tools

 • Send personalized cold
s and conduct LinkedIn outreach

 • Make outbound cold calls

 • Follow up consistently and professionally

 • Qualify opportunities before scheduling

 • Book meetings directly on the CEO’s calendar

 • Maintain clean, accurate CRM records (HubSpot preferred)

 • Continuously refine messaging based on what’s working



Who You’ll Be Targeting

Las Vegas businesses in industries such as:

 • Law firms and professional services

 • Medical and dental offices

 • Real estate brokerages

 • Accounting and CPA firms

 • Construction companies

 • Cannabis operators

 • Any business with 20–200 employees that relies on technology to operate



Requirements

 • Excellent spoken and written English

 • 2+ years of outbound B2B sales or SDR experience

 • Proven cold calling experience

 • Cold
 and LinkedIn prospecting skills

 • CRM experience (HubSpot preferred)

 • Familiarity with Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or ZoomInfo

 • High-speed internet, quiet home office, reliable computer



Bonus Qualifications

Experience selling any of the following is a strong plus:

 • Managed IT or MSP services

 • Cybersecurity

 • Microsoft 365 or cloud services

 • SaaS or technology solutions



What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Learn the Frost Tech story, our services, our target market, and our messaging. Begin prospecting and making calls.

Days 31–60: Booking consistent meetings weekly. Pipeline is growing.

Day 90+: Delivering 10–15 qualified meetings per month with the right decision-makers at the right companies.



Compensation

 • Base Salary: $700–$1,000 USD/month (based on experience)

 • $25 per qualified meeting that shows (paid monthly)

 • Additional commission on closed business — if your meeting turns into a client, you earn ongoing commission

 • Paid holidays after probation period

 • Long-term role with a clear path to Account Executive or Sales Manager as the team grows



Why Frost Tech

This is not a VA role. This is not a ticket queue. You’ll be the person who helps build something real.

We treat our people well. Our team is small, our culture is tight, and the people who work with us stay. You’ll have direct access to a founder who knows how to close and will make the most of every meeting you book.

If you’re serious about a career in tech sales and want to grow with a company that’s on its way up, this is the opportunity.

Conversion rate

Page speed scores

Checkout completion rate

Continuously optimize site speed, UX, CVR, AOV, LTV, and paid media performance

Translate business and marketing objectives into scalable, revenue-focused technical solutions

Provide architectural leadership, code standards, and technical roadmap guidance

8+ years of web/eCommerce development experience with strong commercial acumen

Local Business Hours

High-impact role in a fast-scaling ecommerce brand

Autonomy to architect and lead AI initiatives

Fantastic Team

Competitive salary or contract package

Opportunity to integrate & build next-generation AI systems from the ground up

title: Carrier Sales Representitive.
description:
Carrier Sales Representative



Location:  Remote 

Job Type: Full-Time

Department: Operations / Carrier Sales



About Us



We are a fast-growing freight brokerage dedicated to providing reliable transportation solutions and exceptional customer service. We connect shippers with trusted carrier partners across North America, leveraging industry expertise, technology, and strong relationships to deliver results. We are seeking a motivated and energetic Carrier Sales Representative to join our team and help drive capacity solutions for our customers.



Position Summary



The Carrier Sales Representative is responsible for developing and managing relationships with trucking companies, securing capacity for customer freight, and ensuring successful load execution. This role requires strong negotiation skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.





Key Responsibilities



-Source, negotiate, and secure transportation capacity for customer shipments.

-Build and maintain relationships with carrier partners across multiple modes of transportation.

-Negotiate rates while balancing profitability and service expectations.

-Track and manage shipments from pickup through delivery, proactively addressing any service issues.

-Monitor market conditions and carrier availability to provide competitive transportation solutions.

-Communicate effectively with carriers, customers, and internal teams regarding shipment status and updates.

-Identify and onboard new carrier partners while ensuring compliance with company and industry standards.

-Maintain accurate records within the transportation management system (TMS).

-Meet or exceed individual and team performance goals.



Qualifications Required



*Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

*Ability to multitask and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

*Proficiency with Microsoft Office and general computer applications.

*Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.





Preferred

*Intermediate or fluent in English is a real big plus

*1+ years of experience in freight brokerage, carrier sales, logistics, transportation, or a related field.

*Experience using transportation management systems (TMS) and load boards.

*Knowledge of truckload, LTL, and transportation market dynamics.





What We Offer



*Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission opportunities.

*Paid time off and company holidays.

*Career growth and advancement opportunities.

*Ongoing training and professional development.

*Collaborative and high-energy team environment.



Success in This Role



Top performers in this position are highly motivated, competitive, relationship-driven professionals who excel at building carrier networks, negotiating favorable rates, and ensuring freight moves efficiently and on time.



Ready to join our team? Apply today and help us deliver exceptional transportation solutions across North America





Some general questions: 



On a scale of 1 to 10(10 being the highest) how would you rate your speaking and reading level in English?

How many years of expereince do you have in logistics?

Have you ever worked at a freight brokerage or with a carrier company?

Do you have experience coordinating shipments?

Do you have any experience in tracking and tracing freight shipments?

title: Bid Solicitor
description:
Responsibilities



Market & bench building

*Build and continuously expand TriArc’s qualified trade partner database by trade, geography, capacity, and performance.

*Run ongoing prequalification (financials, safety, workload, bonding) in coordination with Accounting.



Bid strategy & scheduling

*Publish the rolling Bid Calendar; align milestones with Estimators/PMs and owners/architects.

*Break down drawings/specs into clear trade packages; assign scope sheets and alternates.



ITB execution

*Prepare Invitation to Bid packages (drawings, specs, addenda, bid forms, alternates, due dates, delivery method).

*Post to BuildingConnected; segment targeted lists; personalize top-tier outreach.



Relentless follow-up

*3-touch cadence (Day 1
 + Day 3 call/text + Day 5 confirmation) and pre-deadline “nudge” to secure commitments.

*Track interest/no-bid reasons; backfill gaps early; escalate risk areas to Estimating.



Bid intake & leveling

*Receive bids, confirm inclusions/exclusions, and level against scope sheets; flag outliers and VE options.

*Package a clean Bid Leveling Matrix for Estimators/PMs with award recommendation.



Data & feedback loops

*Score and rate trade partner performance post-award (price accuracy, quality, safety, schedule).

*Run post-bid debriefs; capture lessons learned to refine future ITBs.



Brand & relationship

*Be TriArc’s front door for subs: fast answers, fair process, respectful communication, and values-based partnership.



Required Traits & Skills

*Excellent Communication Skills

*Hunter mentality: proactive, persistent, upbeat on the phone; comfortable making 30–50 quality contacts/day in peak cycles.

*Construction fluency: understands typical scopes (CSI divisions), alternates, addenda, and gaps that derail bids.

*Process discipline: lives in checklists, documents everything.

*Communication: crisp writing, professional phone presence, tact with hard-bid deadlines.

*Values fit: Do what you say • Do the right thing • Gumption • Stick-to-itiveness • Passion/Enthusiasm.



Nice-to-Have

*Customer Service / Appointment Setting experience

*GC pre-con/bid desk experience or supplier/manufacturer rep background.

*Existing DFW sub network across interiors, ground-up flex/industrial, retail shells.



Technical Requirements:

*Computer: Intel i5 processor or equivalent with at least 8GB RAM

*Internet: Minimum 50 MBPS download speed

*Dual Monitor is required

*Noise cancellation headset

*HD Cam (Clutter Free, Ideally Plain Well-lit background)



Job Details:

Job Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Schedule: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM CDT - Monday to Friday 9:30 PM - 5:30 AM PHT

Salary Range: PHP 70,000 – 90,000 monthly, depending on experience.

Aroma Armour makes natural shoe fresheners that absorb moisture and eliminate odours helping people keep the shoes they love for longer. We have a growing community of happy customers (parents of sporty kids, athletes, everyday sneaker lovers) and strong reviews. 

Now we're ready to level up our Shopify store to match the quality of our product, more authoritative, more converting, and built to turn first-time buyers into repeat customers.

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance incentives + sales bonuses, with high performers able to earn up to PHP 70,000 per month through bonus opportunities.

Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.

Leave: One week paid leave per year



About the Client



Our client is Australia’s leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating strong long-term career opportunities for high-performing individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, sales-driven role focused on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires strong multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence managing time-sensitive situations.



High-performing tea
mbers who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have the opportunity to progress into leadership roles and eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations



Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-moving dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We’re Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience working with Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or tea
ntoring experience



What’s in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives

- Clear progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work culture

- Long-term career growth opportunities for high performers

title: AI Creative Director & Content Strategist
description:
At Vital Vault, we are building something massive, and we need the creative engine to power it. We aren’t looking for someone to tweak videos or fix typos. We need a visionary. A mastermind. Someone who can look at a blank canvas and leverage cutting-edge AI tools to generate high-impact, high-volume content that commands attention.



The Role: What You’ll Actually Do

If your passion is staring at an editing timeline for 10 hours changing color grades, this is not the job for you. We have systems for that.



Your job is to ideate, direct, and execute. You will be the puppet master of AI content generation tools, using them to create mass content at an unprecedented scale. You will bring the creative spark, and the AI will do the heavy lifting.



Key Responsibilities

Mass Content Generation: Use AI generation tools (text, image, video, audio) to produce a high volume of engaging marketing and brand assets daily.



Creative Direction: Develop the visual identity, tone, and overarching creative strategy for Vital Vault across all digital platforms.



Prompt Engineering & Curation: Masterfully direct AI tools to get the exact aesthetic and emotional response needed, curating the best outputs for public consumption.



Trend Jacking: Have your finger on the pulse of internet culture, shifting our AI output instantly to capitalize on viral 
nts.



Strategy Over Execution: Spend your time thinking, planning, and scaling—not clipping audio or syncing frames.



What We Are Looking For

Note: We care way more about your creative brain and your portfolio than a specific college degree.



The AI Obsessed: You already use Midjourney, Runway, Sora, ChatGPT, or Claude in your sleep. You know how to make AI do what you want.



Mass Output Mindset: You understand that in today's world, volume is king. You know how to scale quality without getting bogged down in perfectionism.



Zero Interest in Editing: You want to build the house, not paint the trim. You excel at the high-level vision and fast-paced generation.



Pure Creativity: You think outside the box, reject boring corporate content, and know how to hook an audience in less than 3 seconds.

title: Social Media Manager Expert
description:
Location: Remote / Flexible



Job Type: [Full-Time]



About Us

We are a growing pet product brand dedicated to making life better for dogs and their humans. We believe our community is the heart of our brand, and we are looking for a creative, proactive storyteller to bring our brand voice to life, elevate our aesthetic, and cultivate a deeply connected community of pet lovers.



The Role

As our Social Media & Community Manager, you won’t just be scheduling posts—you will be the face, voice, and heart of our daily brand presence. We are looking for someone who treats our social channels like a vibrant, welcoming community hub. If you have an eye for design, a passion for authentic engagement, and the drive to bring fresh ideas to the table, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

Creative Content & Aesthetic Curation: Design, shoot, and curate visually stunning, on-brand content (photos, reels/TikToks, stories, and graphics) that elevates our brand aesthetic and resonates with dog owners.



Active Community Engagement: Act as the "real person" behind the page. Responsively monitor and reply to comments, DMs, and questions, ensuring our audience feels heard, valued, and connected in real time.



Drive Organic Growth & Initiative: Don't just follow a content calendar—help build it. We want someone who proactively pitches and executes creative campaigns, interactive polls, and community-building ideas.



User-Generated Content (UGC) Management: Build relationships with our customers and their pups, encouraging, organizing, and celebrating user-generated content.



Launch Recurring Features: Take ownership of community-centric segments—like launching a “Pup of the Week” feature to showcase our customers’ dogs and tell their unique stories to drive deeper engagement.



What We’re Looking For

A Stellar Creative Eye: You have a strong sense of visual aesthetics, branding, and what makes content scroll-stopping.



High Responsiveness & Empathy: You genuinely enjoy chatting with people online. You understand that quick, warm, and helpful responses build lasting customer loyalty.



High Initiative & Autonomy: You are a self-starter who doesn't wait for instructions to innovate. You naturally look for ways to make things more engaging and love seeing your ideas come to life.



Platform Expertise: Deep knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant social platforms, including current trends, audio, and algorithm shifts.



A Passion for Pets: A genuine love for dogs and understanding the pet-parent community is a massive plus!



Why You’ll Love Working With Us

- Flexible remote work environment

- Opportunity to take true ownership of a brand’s creative direction and watch your ideas make a direct impact.

- An endless stream of cute dog photos to work with every single day.



How to Apply

Please send your resume along with a link to your portfolio or social media accounts you've managed. In your application, please include one brief idea for a creative, recurring social media segment you think would help build a community around a pet brand!

title: Ai Savy Video Editor
description:
I create a mix of educational, entertaining, and promotional content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and full-length YouTube videos, and I need a responsive editor who is comfortable blending traditional techniques with the latest AI tools.



Here’s the rhythm I’m after: reels and shorts should feel fast-paced with jump-cuts, trending sound bites, on-screen captions, 3D text overlays/effects, and the kind of punchy motion graphics that stop the scroll, while longer YouTube pieces can breathe a little—simple lower-thirds, clean text animations, and smooth pacing that keeps viewers engaged for five to ten minutes.



Raw assets (talking-head footage, B-roll, screen recordings, brand elements) will be sent or shared with you. I’m already experimenting with Higgsfield, HeyGen, and similar generators for voice-over, avatars, and background plates, so if you can refine those outputs—or suggest better prompts and workflows—even better.



Deliverables

• Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts under 60 s, exported in vertical 1080 × 1920, ready to post

• YouTube videos from 1–10 min, 16:9, 4K or 1080p as required

• Source project files (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve—preferably Resolve but your choice) plus any edited AI assets

• Captions





If this workflow sounds like a fit, show me samples that prove you can keep up the pace on shorts and still craft a coherent narrative in longer cuts. Let’s turn raw footage and AI magic into scroll-stopping videos together

title: Guest Experience Assistant
description:
Guest Services Virtual Assistant 



About Us

Fresh Air Holidays is a dynamic holiday home management company dedicated to providing exceptional stays across the South Coast of England. We manage over 140 holiday homes and work closely with property owners to deliver outstanding guest experiences, ensuring seamless operations and memorable holidays.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, friendly, and detail-oriented Guest Services Virtual Assistant to join our remote team. This role has a strong focus on telephone-based customer service and guest support. You will be one of the first points of contact for our guests and operational teams, answering calls, resolving queries, and ensuring a high level of service is delivered at all times.

You will also support our UK-based team with general administration tasks, guest communications, and assisting our cleaning teams with day-to-day queries. This is a fast-paced and varied role where excellent communication skills, professionalism, and problem-solving abilities are essential.



Key Responsibilities

Guest Communication & Telephone Support

Answer incoming calls from guests in a professional, friendly, and confident manner.

Provide support to guests before, during, and after their stay.

Respond promptly and professionally to guest messages via Airbnb, Booking.com,
, WhatsApp, and other communication channels.

Deliver exceptional customer service and maintain a calm, solution-focused approach when handling issues.

Escalate urgent matters to the appropriate UK team members when required.

Guest Issue Resolution

Assist with troubleshooting common guest issues, including heating, hot tubs, Wi-Fi, access information, and general property queries.

Coordinate with cleaners, maintenance teams, and property owners to resolve guest concerns efficiently.

Keep guests updated throughout the resolution process and ensure issues are followed through to completion.

Support for Cleaning Teams

Act as a point of contact for our cleaning teams and assist with any operational queries they may have.

Help coordinate guest arrivals, departures, changeovers, and any issues identified at properties.

Support cleaners with accessing information and escalating maintenance concerns where necessary.

Reviews & Feedback Management

Monitor, analyse, and respond to guest reviews on platforms such as Airbnb, Booking.com, and Google Reviews.

Identify recurring feedback themes and suggest opportunities for service improvements.

Reservations & Administration

Verify that reservations are fully paid and follow up on any outstanding payments where required.

Check bookings and ensure guest information is accurate and complete.

Update internal systems, spreadsheets, and property information.

Assist with compiling and updating property guides, welcome packs, and other guest-facing materials.

Support the UK team with general administrative tasks and ad hoc projects.



About You

We are looking for someone who is:

Fluent in spoken and written English with a clear and professional telephone manner.

Confident answering and handling a high volume of telephone calls.

Friendly, personable, and able to build rapport with guests and colleagues.

Experienced in customer service, hospitality, travel, or holiday rentals (preferred).

Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

A strong problem-solver who remains calm under pressure.

Tech-savvy and comfortable using booking platforms, spreadsheets, and communication tools.

Proactive, adaptable, and able to work independently whilst remaining a supportive team player.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.



Benefits

Fully remote position.

Opportunity to work with a growing and ambitious holiday rental company.

Friendly, collaborative, and supportive team environment.

Varied and interesting role with genuine responsibility.

Ongoing training and development opportunities.

Potential for career progression as the company continues to grow.



Working Hours (Philippine Time)

This position follows UK operating hours of 12:00 pm – 8:00 pm (UK time), Tuesday to Saturday.

Current Philippine Hours (BST):

Tuesday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Wednesday)

Wednesday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Thursday)

Thursday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Friday)

Friday: 7:00 pm – 3:00 am (Saturday)

Please note: As the UK observes daylight saving time, Philippine working hours will adjust by one hour when the UK changes between British Summer Time (BST) and Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). Applicants must be flexible and comfortable working evening and overnight shifts in the Philippines.



Applicants must have:

A reliable internet connection and suitable home working setup.

A quiet workspace suitable for taking telephone calls.

A professional telephone manner and excellent spoken English.

The ability to work independently and confidently handle guest and operational calls.

title: Tax Accountant/US Tax Preparer
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based tax and accounting firm serving real estate investors, short-term rental hosts, entrepreneurs, and small business owners.



We are looking for an experienced Tax Accountant or Tax Preparer who can assist with tax preparation, bookkeeping review, tax planning support, and client accounting projects.

This is not an entry-level position. We are seeking someone who understands U.S. taxation, enjoys problem-solving, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



Responsibilities

Tax Preparation

Prepare and review Form 1040 individual tax returns 

Prepare and review Form 1065 partnership returns

Prepare and review Form 1120 and 1120S corporate returns

Prepare Schedule C, Schedule E, and rental property reporting

Calculate shareholder and partner basis

Understand book-to-tax adjustments and M-1 reconciliations

Review balance sheets and retained earnings accounts

Review prior-year returns and identify missing information

Assist with amended returns and tax notices as needed

Tax Planning Support

Assist with tax projections and estimated tax calculations

Research tax issues and identify planning opportunities

Understand common strategies such as:

Home office deductions

Augusta Rule

Depreciation and cost segregation

Accountable plans

Hiring family members

Retirement plan contributions

Accounting & Bookkeeping Review

Review bookkeeping files for tax readiness

Analyze financial statements and balance sheet accounts

Review reconciliations and year-end adjustments

Collaborate with bookkeeping staff to ensure accurate reporting



Client Support

Request missing information and maintain tax checklists

Assist with client onboarding and document collection

Communicate professionally with team members and management

Help maintain organized client files and workflows



Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Taxation, or Finance

EA, CPA, or equivalent certification preferred

2+ years preparing U.S. tax returns

Experience working in a U.S. CPA, accounting, or tax firm

Strong understanding of U.S. federal and state taxation

Experience with real estate investors, short-term rentals, and small business owners

Software Experience

title: 3D Architectural Visualization Artist (Exterior + Interior + Animation + Vr tours, Photoreal)
description:

About us



We are a premium 3D architectural visualization studio working with high-end real estate developers in the Netherlands. We do not sell "renders." Hit deadlines without us having to chase you.

A strong portfolio/reel of photoreal architectural work. This is the first thing we look at. No reel, no interview.

Excellent control of lighting, materials, and composition. This is what separates you from the average artist.

The ability to match a detailed visual reference precisely. We give you mood boards and real project photos; your job is to hit that target, not improvise your own style.

Strong, reliable English communication.

Self-managing. You plan your own time and flag problems early.



Nice to have (not required):



Exposure to Dutch or European architecture (brick facades, window proportions, dense new-build neighborhoods). We supply reference packs, so this is a bonus, not a requirement, if you can nail references.

Post-production skills (Photoshop).

Animation / flythrough or real-time experience (D5, Lumion, Unreal).



Software:



We are open. Tell us what you use (D5, Blender, Corona, V-Ray, 3ds Max, Lumion, etc.). Skill and your reel matter more than the specific tool.

Link to your portfolio or reel.

Tell us your main software.

Shortlisted candidates get to do a small test: one render from a Dutch reference brief we provide. If quality matches your promises, you get paid. Otherwise not.

• 3. How do you use technology and AI in your accounting work today, and where do you think it is headed?

title: Competitor Pricing Analyst
description:
Big Little Campers is a premium campervan rental company based in Auckland and Christchurch, New Zealand. We need someone reliable to check a small set of competitor websites every working day and log their rental prices into a spreadsheet, following a fixed checklist. No sales or customer contact involved. This is a data accuracy and consistency role, not a creative one. Precision and showing up every day matter far more than speed.



## What "good" looks like in this role



- Every entry is the genuine final price for the exact scenario specified, not an approximation

- A working screenshot exists for every single row, no exceptions

- The same scenario is checked the same way every week, so the numbers are truly comparable over time

- The weekly session happens on a similar day and at a similar time each week, so the data points stay consistent

- Anything odd gets flagged rather than silently logged and left for someone else to notice weeks later



## What this role does not involve



- No customer contact, no phone calls, no
s to competitors or customers

- No pricing decisions. You are gathering information, not setting or recommending prices

- No scraping tools, scripts, or browser automation. This is a manual, human-eyes-on-the-page check, which is the whole point: it catches things automated tools miss and isn't blocked by bot detection



## Skills and requirements



- Comfortable using Google Sheets (entering data into existing columns, not building formulas)

- Comfortable taking and organising screenshots, and using a shared drive folder

- Good written English for the weekly Slack summary

- Reliable internet connection and consistent weekly availability for a single 3 to 4 hour session

- Previous experience with data entry, market research, or virtual assistant work preferred but not required



## Pay and hours



This role is approximately 3 to 4 hours per week, paid hourly, in one sitting. We'll confirm the exact rate during hiring based on experience and current market rate for this kind of role, benchmarked against listings for similar data entry and market research VA roles on OnlineJobs.ph.



## Onboarding (first two weeks)



- Week 1: Walkthrough call to go through the Competitors tab, Scenarios tab, and Weekly Log tab together, and complete the first week's entries live on the call

- Week 2: Complete the weekly session independently, with a short check-in message once done

- End of week 2: Short review call to check the data quality and answer any questions before this becomes fully independent

Create, manage, and optimize TikTok ad campaigns, reviewing ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and spend

Monitor FBT inventory and coordinate fulfillment across TikTok, Shopify, Amazon MCF, and other approved sources

Troubleshoot product sync, inventory sync, order routing, and marketplace integration issues

Prepare weekly performance reports and recommend actions for campaigns, promotions, and creator outreach

Help build SOPs, trackers, and systems as the channel grows



Required Experience

TikTok Shop Seller Center, Affiliate Center, and Ads Manager

Creator outreach, free samples, and campaign management

FBT, seller-fulfilled orders, order SLA, and account health

Shopify and marketplace integrations

Strong spreadsheet, reporting, and communication skills



Preferred

Tools like Kalodata, Euka.ai, TikTok Analytics, or inventory sync platforms

Experience with peak season creator campaigns and SOP creation

Experience leading or training team members



What We Are Looking For

Someone honest, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership. You solve problems without waiting to be told every step, communicate clearly, and want to grow long-term with the company.



Work With Us ????

We believe comfort, creativity, and confidence can make a meaningful impact in people's everyday lives. What started as a gift idea has grown into a seven-figure e-commerce brand with a loyal customer base and ambitious plans for continued growth.



We're a fast-growing, founder-led business where creativity, data, and heart come together. Every team member plays an important role in helping us build products, experiences, and content that connect with customers and bring joy to their daily lives.



Our products are sold through major e-commerce marketplaces and supported by a passionate community of creators, customers, and brand advocates. From marketing and operations to product development and customer experience, our team thrives on collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and kindness.



We're a small but mighty team where ideas are valued, initiative is encouraged, and great work is recognized. We move quickly, embrace challenges, and believe that some of the best opportunities come from thinking differently and staying adaptable.



Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Meaningful mission focused on creating products that make people's lives better

• Creative, entrepreneurial culture that values innovation and initiative

• Remote flexibility with a collaborative and supportive team environment

• Opportunity to grow alongside a rapidly expanding consumer brand

• Transparent leadership and direct access to decision-makers

• The ability to make a real impact and see your ideas come to life quickly

• A company built on resilience, imagination, and continuous improvement



If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute, grow, and help build something meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Credit Repair Specialist / Credit Dispute Processor.
description:
We are seeking an experienced Credit Repair Specialist to join our growing credit repair company. This is not a general virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone with hands-on experience in credit repair, dispute processing, credit report analysis, CFPB complaints, and client onboarding.



The ideal candidate should be able to independently manage client files from onboarding through the dispute process with minimal supervision.



Responsibilities:



• Client onboarding and account setup

• Collecting and reviewing required client documents

• Ensuring all onboarding requirements are completed before disputes begin

• Reviewing and analyzing credit reports from all three bureaus

• Identifying inaccurate, unverifiable, outdated, and incomplete information

• Preparing dispute strategies based on FCRA and CROA guidelines

• Submitting disputes through online bureau accounts

• Managing dispute rounds and tracking bureau responses

• Preparing and submitting CFPB complaints when appropriate

• Updating client files and maintaining accurate records

• Managing client communications regarding missing documents and account updates

• Working within Credit Repair Cloud and SmartCredit

• Monitoring client progress and reporting updates



Requirements:



• Previous experience working for a credit repair company

• Strong understanding of FCRA, FDCPA, and CROA

• Experience analyzing credit reports

• Experience preparing dispute letters and dispute strategies

• Experience filing CFPB complaints

• Familiarity with Credit Repair Cloud

• Familiarity with SmartCredit

• Excellent English communication skills

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work independently

• Reliable internet connection



Preferred Qualifications:



• 2+ years of credit repair experience

• Experience handling multiple client files simultaneously

• Knowledge of Metro 2 reporting standards

• Experience with consumer law and credit reporting regulations



Schedule:



• Part-Time

• Approximately 20 hours per week

• Flexible schedule

• Must be available for occasional meetings during Pacific Time business hours



To Apply:



Please submit:



Resume

Short introduction video

Description of your credit repair experience

Experience with Credit Repair Cloud

Experience with SmartCredit

Experience with CFPB complaints

Number of client files managed at one time



IMPORTANT: To confirm you have read this posting, begin your application with the phrase:



"I pay attention to details."

title: Senior SEO Specialist (Technical SEO & Content)
description:
?



About Express Media



Express Media is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency focused on helping businesses generate more leads through modern SEO.



We build long-term organic growth strategies for local businesses, service companies, ecommerce brands, and national clients.



Current clients include:



* Steadfast Storm Shelters

* Blue Ribbon Septic

* Lake Martin Storm Shelters

* Families United

* Vatos Tacos



We’re looking for an experienced SEO professional who understands today’s search landscape and can help clients grow through quality SEO—not outdated tactics.



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We are looking for one exceptional SEO professional—not a team or agency. Individual applicants only.



?



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll manage SEO across multiple client websites.



Responsibilities include:



* Keyword Research

* Search Intent Analysis

* Keyword Clustering

* Technical SEO Audits

* On-Page SEO

* Internal Linking

* Content Planning

* Content Optimization

* Competitor Research

* Content Gap Analysis

* Keyword Cannibalization Analysis

* SEO Reporting

* Schema Recommendations

* Local SEO

* Site Architecture Reviews

* SEO QA before publishing



You’ll work directly with management to improve rankings, traffic, and lead generation across multiple industries.



?



Required Skills



You should already be comfortable with:



* Modern SEO best practices

* Technical SEO

* Local SEO

* Content SEO

* Search Intent

* Internal Linking

* Keyword Research

* Keyword Clustering

* Schema Markup

* Site Architecture

* Competitor Analysis

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics



?



Software Experience



Required:



* SEMrush

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics

* Screaming Frog

* Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Teams, OneDrive)

* Microsoft Excel

* ChatGPT or similar AI tools



Required CMS Experience:



* WordPress

* Webflow



Nice to Have:



* Shopify

* Looker Studio

* Zapier

* Make

* n8n



?



Work Schedule (Required)



This is a full-time remote position.



You must be available during U.S. Central Time (CST/CDT) business hours.



Required schedule:



* Monday through Friday

* Approximately 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time



You will communicate with management throughout the workday using Microsoft Teams.



Please do not apply if you cannot consistently work U.S. Central Time.



?



This Position Is NOT For You If…



* You think SEO is mostly backlinks.

* You rely entirely on AI to write content.

* You keyword stuff.

* You don’t understand search intent.

* You have never completed a technical SEO audit.

* You don’t know how to identify keyword cannibalization.

* You’re unwilling to continue learning as SEO evolves.



?



We’re Looking For Someone Who…



* Thinks strategically instead of simply following checklists.

* Pays close attention to detail.

* Can solve problems independently.

* Writes excellent English.

* Understands technical SEO.

* Loves learning.

* Is organized.

* Communicates well.

* Takes ownership of projects.

* Can manage multiple client accounts.

* Is dependable and responsive during business hours.



?



Experience Required



Minimum 3 years of professional SEO experience.



Required experience:



* Local SEO

* Technical SEO

* Content SEO

* Internal Linking

* Keyword Research

* Keyword Clustering

* Search Intent Mapping

* Site Architecture

* Schema Markup

* Google Search Console

* Screaming Frog

* WordPress

* Webflow



Bonus:



* Shopify

* Local Service Businesses

* Ecommerce

* AI-assisted workflows



?



Our Standards



We don’t publish content because it’s “good enough.”



Every page should have a clear purpose and provide value to users.



We care about:



* Search Intent

* Helpful Content

* Technical Excellence

* Clean Site Architecture

* User Experience

* Long-Term Rankings

* Ethical SEO Practices



?



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days you’ll help:



* Improve rankings across multiple client websites.

* Identify and fix technical SEO issues.

* Improve internal linking.

* Eliminate keyword cannibalization.

* Increase qualified organic traffic.

* Increase client leads.

* Build scalable SEO processes.



?



To Apply



Your application must include:



1. Your resume.

2. Links to three websites you’ve personally improved with SEO.

3. Explain your role on each project.

4. What is the biggest SEO mistake businesses make today?

5. Explain the difference between:



* Search Intent

* Topical Authority

* Keyword Cannibalization



6. What is the first thing you do when starting a brand-new SEO project?

7. Which SEO tools do you personally use every week?

8. How do you currently use AI in your workflow?

9. Tell us about your biggest SEO success.

10. Describe how you would identify and fix keyword cannibalization.

11. Describe your process for creating an internal linking strategy.

12. At the very top of your application include these words:



Blue Rhino



Applications without those words will not be considered.



?



Why Join Express Media?



You’ll work directly with leadership on real client campaigns and help build SEO strategies that drive measurable business growth.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving challenging SEO problems, takes pride in producing high-quality work, and wants to grow with our agency for years to come.

title: Social Media VA ( AI and Creation of AI Avatars)
description:
We are looking for a creative and AI-savvy Social Media Virtual Assistant to support a Singapore-based business in growing its online presence through innovative content creation and organic social media strategies.



The ideal candidate should be highly proficient in AI tools and AI avatar creation, capable of producing engaging video content, and confident in advising the client on strategies to improve organic growth across social media platforms.



Experience in the automobile industry or apparel/fashion marketing is an advantage but not required.



Key Responsibilities

Create and manage social media content across platforms such as
, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube

Develop and produce AI-generated content and AI avatars for social media campaigns

Create, edit, and publish engaging video content optimized for social media

Brainstorm and recommend content ideas aligned with the client's branding and goals

Advise the client on organic social media growth strategies

Monitor content performance and suggest improvements to increase reach and engagement

Stay updated with emerging AI tools, social media trends, and content strategies

Assist with content scheduling and social media management



Required Skills & Qualifications

Proven experience as a Social Media VA, Social Media Manager, or Content Creator

Strong proficiency in AI tools and AI avatar creation platforms

Experience creating and editing video-based content

Strong understanding of social media growth strategies and audience engagement

Ability to independently generate content ideas and marketing recommendations

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Creative mindset with strong storytelling abilities



What We're Looking For

Someone passionate about AI-driven content creation

A strategic thinker who can advise on organic growth opportunities

A creative individual who can turn ideas into engaging video content

Someone who stays ahead of AI and social media trends

A proactive and independent team player



Nice to Have

Experience in the automobile industry

Experience with apparel or fashion brand marketing

Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Veo, HeyGen, Synthesia, ElevenLabs, or similar platforms

Experience creating AI influencers, AI avatars, or AI-generated marketing content



Top 3 Key Requirements

Strong proficiency in AI tools and AI avatar creation.

40

RESPONSIBILITIES

Coordinating with internal tea

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Please only apply if you have real experience with project management, construction, engineering coordination, solar, electrical, or a closely related field.



Strong candidates should have experience with some or all of the following:



Commercial solar project management

Public works or government-funded construction projects

Commercial construction coordination

Electrical construction or renewable energy projects

Reading construction plans, electrical plans, single line diagrams, and specifications

Project schedules, RFIs, submittals, change orders, and closeout documentation

Coordinating vendors, subcontractors, engineers, and field crews

Customer and stakeholder communication

Managing multiple projects at the same time

BIG PLUS

Experience with GSA government contract work

Existing relationships with government agencies, public works departments, schools, municipalities, military bases, or commercial property owners

Experience with U.S. public works requirements

Experience with commercial solar carports

Experience with battery energy storage systems

Experience with utility interconnection

Experience with prevailing wage documentation or certified payroll coordination

Experience with California construction projects

Experience using CRMs or project management software such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Project, Monday, Asana, ClickUp, Buildertrend, Procore, or similar tools

REQUIRED SKILLS



The right person must be:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

A strong written communicator

Comfortable communicating in English

Able to follow up with people until tasks are complete

Able to manage deadlines and competing priorities

Proactive and resourceful

Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear

Able to work independently

Professional when communicating with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal tea
mbers

Strong at documentation and keeping clean project records

ENGLISH REQUIREMENT



Excellent written English is required.



Strong spoken English is preferred because this role may involve internal meetings, vendor calls, customer updates, and project coordination.



TO APPLY



Please reply with the following:



Your project management experience

Your commercial solar, electrical, construction, or engineering coordination experience

The largest project you have helped manage, including approximate contract value and your role

Commercial Solar PM — [Your Name]

title: Virtual Math & ELA Teacher
description:
We are looking for a dedicated and tech-savvy Virtual Math and ELA Teacher to work with middle school students in grades 6–8. This is more than a traditional teaching position we need an educator who thinks like an analyst. You will regularly review student performance data and use those insights to design personalized, targeted lesson plans that help each student grow academically.



This role is 100% remote. You will teach live virtual sessions, communicate with parents, and collaborate with our team in daily check-ins. If you are passionate about student outcomes and comfortable working in a data-informed environment, we want to hear from you.





Responsibilities



Teaching & Instruction

Deliver live, virtual lessons in Math and/or English Language Arts (ELA) for grades 6–8

Follow each student’s personalized learning plan to guide instruction

Host small-group or one-on-one virtual classroom sessions via Zoom, using breakout rooms to differentiate instruction

Provide re-instruction and targeted support for students who need additional practice or academic intervention



Data Analysis & Lesson Planning

Review and analyze student performance data including assessment scores, progress reports, and learning trends

Use data findings to build and adjust lesson plans that directly address each student’s strengths and gaps

Track student growth over time and adjust strategies based on measurable outcomes



Communication & Collaboration

Maintain regular communication with parents and guardians, providing clear and timely progress updates

Attend one daily administrative meeting (1 hour) with the team to align on student needs, goals, and school updates

Collaborate with other educators and staff to ensure a consistent and supportive learning experience for all students





Requirements



Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Education, Mathematics, English, or a related field

Prior experience teaching or tutoring middle school students (grades 6–8)

Experience with data-driven instruction or student performance analysis is strongly preferred



Technical Requirements

Reliable laptop or desktop computer with a stable, high-speed internet connection

Proficiency with Zoom, including the ability to manage breakout rooms and screen sharing

Comfort with digital tools such as Google Classroom, Google Sheets, or similar platforms for tracking and communication



Skills & Qualities

Strong analytical mindset — able to interpret student data and translate it into actionable lesson plans

Clear and professional communication skills, both written and spoken

Organized, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively in a remote environment

Caring, patient, and student-centered approach to education





What a Typical Day Looks Like



Review student data and performance updates from the previous day

Prepare or adjust lesson plans based on data insights

Host live virtual classroom sessions with students via Zoom (small groups or one-on-one)

Check in with parents via
 or messaging to share updates and address any concerns

Attend a 1-hour daily administrative meeting with the school team

Document session notes, student progress, and any follow-up actions needed

title: OJT - Vibe Coder - Remote
description:
Vibe Coder – Remote On-the-Job Training (OJT)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Duration: 6-month OJT (potential full-time conversion)

Hours: 40 hours/week

Stipend: TBD (open for discussion based on experience)





THE ROLE

You'll be building the actual software that runs our ventures — and learning how real software gets shipped in a

live, fast-moving business environment.

We don't have time for slow sprints. We have more ideas than hands. Dashboards our clients demand. Internal

tools our teams stitch together in spreadsheets. Client-facing portals that need to exist. Snap & Prospect

automation pipelines. And someone needs to make them real.

That someone is you — but we'll teach you how.



What you'll actually do:

• Build real, shipped tools — not homework projects. CRM enrichment scripts, onboarding workflows,

recruiter dashboards, automation glue between Gmail/Sheets/Telegram/Slack. You'll see your code running in

production within weeks, not months.

• Learn by doing — We'll pair you with our team on live builds. You'll see what good code looks like (and what

bad code looks like). You'll learn when an AI is being helpful vs. when it's confidently wrong. You'll ship messy

v1s and iterate based on real feedback.

• Own the full loop — Spec (usually from a Slack message or voice note), build, deploy, iterate. We give

direction; you ship.

• Treat AI as a co-builder, not a crutch — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — these are your tools. You'll learn

to work with AI, not just at AI.

• Move fast — When someone says "what if we…", you'll prototype something demo-able in a day or two, not

request a Gantt chart.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You don't need 5 years of experience. You need the right foundation and mindset.



Must-have:

-Technically capable — You've built something that ran. A side project. A class assignment you actually

finished. A startup idea you coded. It doesn't need to be polished; it needs to be real.

-AI-native — You think in AI. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily. You can articulate your actual

workflow (not "I sometimes use Copilot"). You're comfortable asking an LLM for code and know how to spot

when it's lying.

- Systems thinking — Either you're a CS/IT student or recent grad who understands databases, APIs, and

deployment, OR you're a business/entrepreneurship student who's built a venture or prototype and understands

how systems need to work to solve real problems.

-Hunger to ship — You get frustrated by endless meetings. You want to see your work in the world. You're

willing to learn in public.

-Communication — Half our briefs come as voice notes. You're okay with ambiguity and can ask clarifying

questions without needing a 30-page spec.



Nice to have:

-You've built something with Claude Code or Cursor and can talk about what worked/didn't

-You're comfortable with: Next.js, React Native, FastAPI, Node, Supabase, Vercel

-You've touched:
 bots, Gmail/Drive APIs, automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier)

-You understand business tools: CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive), recruiting ops, or SME workflows

-You're based in the Philippines and understand SEA or Australian SME operations



THE OJT ADVANTAGE

This isn't a typical internship. You're not making coffee or organizing files.

-You'll ship real code to real users within your first month

-You'll learn modern development the way it's actually done in 2026 — with AI as a first-class teammate

-You'll work across the full stack — no "frontend only" silos; you'll touch API design, database schemas,

deployment, customer feedback loops

-You'll build a portfolio of deployed projects you can show future employers

-You'll earn a stipend (negotiable) + potential full-time offer at the end if it's a good fit

-You'll be paid for your time — not exploited as free labor



HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. A short note (200 words max) on:

• The most interesting thing you've built (could be a hackathon project, class assignment, side project, startup

idea)

• What it does

• What tools you used (especially if you used AI)

• What you'd do differently if you built it again

2. Show your work:

• GitHub links (even half-finished projects)

• Deployed apps or links to live projects

• Screenshots, demo videos, or Loom walkthroughs

• If you built something with Claude Code or Cursor, please include it

3. Optional but encouraged (60–90 minutes):

Pick one and build it using Claude Code, Cursor, or your favorite AI-native tool. Don't polish it. Send us the

messy version + a 2-minute Loom walkthrough explaining what you built and what you'd change.

Option A: A CSV-to-personalized
 generator (upload contacts , generate personalized drafts)

Option B: A
 bot that logs voice notes into a Google Sheet with auto-generated summaries

Option C: A mini dashboard that pulls from a public API (weather, crypto prices, GitHub repos, whatever) and

displays something useful



Send your code + Loom to:

title: Web Developer | GEO & AI Search Technical Specialist
description:
We are an AI marketing firm based in Atlanta, Georgia. We specialize in Generative Engine Optimization, helping local businesses appear in AI-generated search results on ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot. We are building a scalable service delivery operation and need a technically strong web developer to implement backend fixes that make our clients' websites readable, crawlable, and citable by AI search engines.



This is not a design role. This is a technical implementation role focused on schema markup, site performance, crawlability, structured data, and CMS-level content publishing. You will receive clear task lists generated from our OtterlyAI audit platform and execute them precisely.



What You Will Do

Schema Markup Implementation (Primary Focus)

This is the most important technical task in our service delivery. You will build and deploy JSON-LD structured data for every client website. Every new client requires a complete schema implementation in Month 1. Ongoing clients receive schema updates as their services or information changes.



Specific schema types you will implement regularly:

LocalBusiness schema with full NAP data (name, address, phone), service area, business hours, geo coordinates, and founding date where available. Service schema for each individual service a client offers, linked to the parent LocalBusiness entity. FAQPage schema on all key service pages. BreadcrumbList schema for site navigation. Review and AggregateRating schema where client has verifiable review data. OpeningHoursSpecification for businesses with complex or 24/7 schedules, which is critical for HVAC and towing clients.

All schema is implemented as JSON-LD in the page head. Never inline RDFa. Test every implementation using Google's Rich Results Test and 
 validator before marking complete.

AI Crawlability Fixes

You will receive crawlability reports from OtterlyAI identifying technical barriers preventing AI bots from reading client websites. Your job is to resolve each flagged item.



Common fixes you will execute:

Robots.txt audits and corrections. Many client websites block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, or other AI crawlers either intentionally or by a
 through legacy configurations. You will identify blocked bots and add the appropriate allow directives. JavaScript rendering fixes. Content loaded via JavaScript is invisible to most AI crawlers. You will identify pages where key service content, contact information, or structured data is rendered client-side and implement server-side rendering or static fallback content so AI bots see the full page. Page speed improvements affecting crawl budget. Compress images, implement lazy loading, clean up unused scripts, and verify Core Web Vitals are not causing crawlers to time out or deprioritize the site. XML sitemap verification and submission. Confirm sitemaps are current, include all key service pages, and are submitted to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools. Canonical tag review to ensure AI crawlers are not indexing duplicate or thin content pages.



WordPress and CMS Implementation

The majority of our clients are on WordPress. Some may be on Wix, Squarespace, or custom HTML sites. You will:

Publish GEO-optimized content written by our Claude AI workflow. Content arrives formatted and ready. Your job is to publish it correctly with proper heading structure (H1, H2, H3 hierarchy), internal links to relevant service pages, meta title and meta description populated, correct category and tag assignments, and featured image added if provided.

Install and configure Yoast SEO or Rank Math on WordPress sites that do not already have an SEO plugin. Configure site-wide settings: organization schema at site level, social profiles linked, XML sitemap enabled.

Create new service pages when our content team produces content for services a client has not previously featured on their website. These pages need to match the existing site design, load correctly on mobile, and pass the OtterlyAI crawlability check before being marked complete.



Monthly Technical Maintenance

Each month you will receive a short technical task list per active client based on the latest OtterlyAI audit recommendations. Typical monthly tasks include updating schema when client hours, services, or pricing changes, fixing any crawlability issues flagged in the weekly audit, publishing new content articles produced by the VA and Claude workflow, and verifying that previously implemented schema is still valid and rendering correctly.

You will log all completed tasks in our shared Google Sheet client tracker with the date completed and any notes for the team.



Occasional Development Projects

As we grows you may be asked to build simple landing pages for specific service areas, implement tracking pixels for Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, connect client websites to Google Business Profile APIs for automated data syncing, and support the eventual integration of OtterlyAI API data into client reporting dashboards.



Tools and Technologies

You must be proficient in these before applying:



WordPress (theme editing, plugin configuration, page publishing, settings management)

JSON-LD schema markup (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList at minimum)

HTML and CSS (sufficient to edit page templates and fix rendering issues)

Google Search Console (sitemap submission, crawl error identification, index coverage review)

Bing Webmaster Tools (sitemap submission, crawl verification)

Google Rich Results Test and 
 Validator

robots.txt configuration

Basic JavaScript debugging (sufficient to identify JS-rendered content problems)

Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager (basic implementation)



Familiarity with these is a strong advantage:



Yoast SEO or Rank Math plugin configuration

Core Web Vitals optimization

Cloudflare or similar CDN configuration

Wix, Squarespace, or Webflow (for non-WordPress clients)

Google Business Profile API

n8n or 
 (for future automation work)



Who You Are

You are technically precise. Schema errors, unclosed tags, and broken robots.txt configurations are things you catch before they cause problems, not after.

You are fast but not careless. Our clients pay monthly retainers and their monthly deliverables need to go out on schedule. You understand deadlines and communicate proactively when something will take longer than expected.

You can work from a task list without needing to redesign everything. We are not asking you to rebuild client websites. We are asking you to implement specific technical improvements to existing sites. You follow the brief exactly and ask for clarification before making assumptions.

You understand why the technical work you are doing matters to AI search. You do not need to be a GEO expert, but you should understand at the level of "schema markup helps AI tools understand what this business is and where it is" so you can make intelligent decisions when the task list has ambiguity.

You communicate in English clearly and professionally. You will interact with the team lead and occasionally with the VA team. Written communication needs to be clean and unambiguous.



Requirements

Minimum 2 years of professional web development experience

Demonstrated experience with schema markup implementation, with examples you can show

Strong WordPress proficiency across multiple client sites simultaneously

Reliable high-speed internet with backup option

Available for a minimum of 10 to 15 hours per week with potential to grow

Ability to turn around standard technical tasks (schema implementation, robots.txt fix, content publishing) within 24 to 48 hours of receiving the task





What We Offer



Good base pay. 

A team of strong, integrous individuals. 

Part-time to start (10 to 15 hours per week) with clear growth path as client volume increases

Fully remote and asynchronous work

Clear task lists generated from our audit platform, no ambiguity about what needs to be done

Long-term stable engagement built on monthly client retainers, not project-based gigs

Paid training on OtterlyAI audit outputs and GEO-specific technical requirements

Direct access to the firm owner for priority questions



How to Apply

Cover letter - Include the following:

Two examples of schema markup you have implemented on live websites. Paste the JSON-LD code directly in your
 or provide URLs where we can verify it with Google's Rich Results Test. If you have never implemented a schema, do not apply.



A brief description of a robots.txt problem you identified and fixed on a client site. What was blocked, how did you find it, and what did you change?

Your WordPress experience summary: how many sites have you managed simultaneously, which plugins you know well, and whether you have worked in multisite environments.

Your available hours, time zone, and typical turnaround time for a standard schema implementation task.



Applications without all four items will not be reviewed. Applications that say "see my portfolio" instead of answering the questions directly will not be reviewed.

title: Executive Assistant to the Chief Operating Officer
description:
Please apply on the link below:







What We Offer

- Starting salary of $1,300+/month USD, with room to grow based on demonstrated experience and judgment

- Direct working relationship with the COO of a fast-scaling creator agency; you'll see how senior decisions actually get made

- A role where you're trusted, not micromanaged, trained early, then given your lane to run

- Daily exposure to AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) used at a professional level

- 100% remote, Philippines-based, full-time (8 hrs/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours

- A genuine career-defining seat for an experienced EA, close to the executive table, broad exposure across the business



The Role

Be the Second Brain to a Senior Executive at a Fast-Growing Creator Agency | $1,300+/month | 100% Remote, Philippines.



The COO of this agency is at capacity. He's currently doing all of it himself -- updating trackers, chasing people, drafting documents, building workflows, managing calendar conflicts, thinking through hard conversations alone. Every hour spent on that is an hour not spent on the work only a COO can do. This is the role that fixes that.



We're hiring an Executive Assistant who can absorb the COO's recurring admin and execution load, at high volume, at speed, and to a standard he can trust without checking. You'll own the doing so he can own the d
. This is not a hand-holding role. You'll be trained early, then trusted to run your lane.



The right person for this seat doesn't wait to be told the next step. They take the brief and run. They see the work that needs doing before being asked. And they're the kind of operator a COO can hand something off to and consider it handled.





What You'll Own

- Project and tracker management. Keep all the COO's project trackers and statuses current in Airtable. Maintain visibility on what's moving, what's stuck, and what's due. Nothing falls through.

- Follow-ups and chasing. Own the follow-up loop end-to-end. Chase outstanding items, send the reminders, surface blockers to the COO before they become problems.

- Document drafting. Draft documents the COO would otherwise write himself; to a standard he can route straight for approval without rewriting.

- Workflow builds in ProcessStreet. Build straightforward, repeatable workflows so the COO doesn't have to. Examples: one-off task workflows, leave handoff workflows where leave isn't approved until a handoff plan is filled out and routed.

- Process builds for capacity-constrained department heads. When a department head is buried, build their process for them under the COO's direction. Example: standing up a hiring or onboarding workflow when the owner is buried in interviews.

- Calendar and scheduling. Manage the COO's calendar, resolve meeting overlaps, find times that work across multiple people's schedules.

- Thinking partner. Act as a sounding board on draining or tricky calls. Offer a different angle on how to approach a hard conversation. Handle the legwork of putting things into Claude for the COO.





What You Bring:

Experience (non-negotiable)

- Prior experience as an EA to a senior executive. We want someone who already understands the cadence of supporting an exec at this level; not someone learning it for the first time.

- Comfortable operating at pace across many small parallel tasks. This role is high-volume throughput, not deep specialist work.

Skills (must-have)
