title: AI-Assisted Fiction Writer / Genre Story Developer
description:
Job Description:



We are looking for a reliable fiction writer to help create 30,000-word genre fiction stories for an established digital publishing brand.



This is an ongoing role for someone who understands story structure, genre conventions, pacing, character motivation, and reader expectations. The ideal candidate enjoys working with AI writing tools and knows how to guide a story from concept to finished manuscript while keeping it cohesive, emotionally engaging, and aligned with the target genre.



You will not be writing every word from scratch. Instead, you will use AI tools as part of the writing process. Your job will be to plan the story, develop the plot, guide the AI, revise the output, fix continuity issues, improve character consistency, and make sure the finished manuscript reads like a polished, satisfying genre story.



We publish in fiction categories such as romance, horror, thriller, fantasy, and science fiction. Experience in any of these genres is welcome. Strong understanding of romance fiction is a plus.



Responsibilities:



Create and refine story concepts based on provided tropes, themes, story titles, and publishing goals.



Develop clear plots, chapter-by-chapter outlines, character arcs, and story beats.



Use AI tools to generate 30,000-word stories based on approved outlines and creative direction.



Keep the AI-generated story on track, avoiding repetition, contradictions, weak pacing, random plot turns, or scenes that do not serve the story.



Revise and polish AI-generated text so the final manuscript feels cohesive, natural, emotionally engaging, and aligned with genre expectations.



Ensure characters remain consistent in voice, motivation, behavior, and relationship dynamics.



Strengthen pacing, tension, conflict, hooks, chapter endings, and emotional payoff.



Follow brand style, formatting, and quality guidelines.



Communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and revise based on feedback.



Maintain confidentiality about pen names, book concepts, prompts, workflows, and publishing strategy.



Genres We Are Interested In:



Romance



Horror



Thriller



Fantasy



Science fiction



Paranormal or supernatural fiction



Suspense-driven character stories



You do not need experience in every genre. We are most interested in writers who understand how genre fiction works and can learn specific reader expectations quickly.



Requirements:



Excellent written English.



The phrase 'purple pop tarts' somewhere in your application, so I know you thoroughly read this job posting.



Strong understanding of fiction structure, pacing, character motivation, and genre conventions.



Experience writing fiction, outlining fiction, editing fiction, or developing stories.



Comfort using AI writing tools as part of the creative process.



Ability to guide AI output instead of simply accepting whatever it produces.



Ability to identify and fix weak scenes, continuity issues, inconsistent characters, slow pacing, and unsatisfying endings.



Reliable, responsive, detail-oriented, and able to follow instructions carefully.



No plagiarism, no copied material, and no reused content from previous work.



Preferred Skills:



Experience with romance, horror, thriller, fantasy, or science fiction.



Understanding of popular genre tropes and reader expectations.



Ability to create strong hooks, emotional tension, suspense, and satisfying endings.



Experience working from outlines, beats, or detailed creative direction.



Experience revising AI-generated writing into polished fiction.



To Apply:



Please send:



A short introduction about your fiction writing experience.

Which genres you understand best: romance, horror, thriller, fantasy, science fiction, or other.

Any pertinent fiction writing samples you have.

Your experience using AI writing tools for storytelling, outlining, drafting, or editing.

Confirmation that you understand the pay is $500 USD a month for one 30,000-word story a week, submitted by Friday close of business each week at the latest.

The answer to this question: What makes a genre story satisfying for readers?



Applications without writing samples will not be considered.



Note: We believe in responsible autonomy and treat everyone as an adult. This means you will be treated with respect and not micromanaged. We do not request that any software be installed on your computer to track hours or activity or anything of this nature. We also don't believe in time sheets, or anything like that. As long as you submit an original, plagiarism-free, on-brand and in-line with genre expectations, 30,000-word story each week we are 100% happy.



When you first start this endeavor, it will likely take you close to 40 hours to complete each week. After two months, most of our tea
mbers can successfully produce a story in 20-30 hours, with our top performers generating a story each day or two and doubling, or in very rare and exceptional cases more that doubling, their monthly take-home pay via content and performance bonuses. While there is no guarantee you'll make content or performance bonuses we greatly hope you do, because it means we are both winning together. If we all win, everything works better.



Thank you and we look forward to hearing from qualified applicants soon.

title: GEO & AI Visibility Specialist | Marketing Agency VA
description:
We are a growing marketing firm that helps local businesses in North Atlanta, Georgia get found by ChatGPT, Google AI, and Perplexity when their customers search for services. We use a cutting-edge process called Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to make our clients visible in AI search results, and we are growing fast.



We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who will become the engine behind our client delivery. This is not a general admin role. This is a specialized marketing operations position where you will learn skills that are in extremely high demand in 2026 and beyond.



What You Will Do

AI Visibility Monitoring (Weekly)

Set up and manage client workspaces inside OtterlyAI, our AI search tracking platform. Load search prompts for each client. Review weekly audit results and recommendations. Log findings into our client tracking spreadsheet. Flag any significant changes in client visibility scores to the team lead.

GEO Audit Execution (Per New Client)

Run the OtterlyAI GEO Content Audit and AI Crawlability Check on new client websites. Run the AI Brand Authority Check to assess whether AI tools recognize the client as a trusted entity. Document all audit findings clearly in our standardized Google Sheet template. Use Claude AI to generate the client findings summary using our master prompt template. Populate the one-page Canva audit report with the client's data and Claude's narrative. Submit the completed report for review before it goes to the client.

Content Publishing (Weekly Per Client)

Take Claude-written GEO articles and publish them to client websites using WordPress or their CMS. Format content correctly: proper headings, FAQ sections, internal links, and meta descriptions. Resize and add any images provided. Confirm published URLs and log them in the content tracker.

Google Business Profile Management (Monthly Per Client)

Audit each client's Google Business Profile for completeness. Update business hours, services, service area, photos, and descriptions as directed. Post monthly GBP updates using content provided by Claude. Request and track Google reviews using our review outreach templates. Log review counts and ratings in the client scorecard monthly.

Directory and Citation Building (Month 1 Per Client)

Submit client business information to approved industry directories for their category. HVAC clients go on Angi, HomeAdvisor, ACCA directory, and local chamber listings. Towing clients go on Yelp, Roadside America, and Google Business. Window clients go on Houzz, HomeAdvisor, Angi, and manufacturer dealer locator pages. Accounting clients go on CPA directories and local chamber. IT clients go on Clutch.co and relevant tech directories. Confirm all submissions are live and log them in the citation tracker.

Monthly Client Reporting (Monthly Per Client)

Pull the monthly visibility score from OtterlyAI for each client. Log before and after scores in the client scorecard. Feed the data into Claude using our monthly report prompt to generate the narrative. Populate the branded Canva report template with the new data and Claude's summary. Submit to team lead for review before sending to client.

Follow-Up Sequence Management (Ongoing)

Send follow-up texts and
s to prospects using our pre-written templates after audit deliveries. Log all outreach in the follow-up tracker with dates and response status. Remind team lead when Day 3, Day 7, and Day 14 follow-up actions are due. Update prospect status in the tracker when they respond or go silent.



Tools You Will Use

You do not need to know all of these on day one. We will train you on each one. Comfort with learning new software quickly is more important than prior experience with any specific tool.



OtterlyAI (AI visibility tracking and GEO audits)

Claude AI (content generation and report writing)

Google Sheets (client tracking, audit logs, scorecards)

Canva (report templates, one-page client deliverables)

WordPress (content publishing)

Google Business Profile Manager

Google Drive (file storage and sharing)

Slack or similar (team communication)

Calendly or similar (appointment tracking)



Who You Are

Kind, hardworking, eager for coaching.

You are highly organized and detail-oriented. You do not skip steps. You follow SOPs exactly as written and flag anything that is unclear rather than guessing.

You are comfortable with AI tools and genuinely curious about how they work. You do not need to be a developer or a writer. You need to be someone who can follow a clear process and execute it consistently.

You have excellent written English. You will read audit data, populate report templates, and send professional, client-facing
s using our pre-written copy. Nothing you write goes to a client without review, but your baseline written English must be clean and professional.

You are proactive about communication. If you finish a task early, you report it. If you hit a blocker, you raise it immediately rather than sitting on it. If something in a client's audit looks unusual, you flag it.

You are reliable and available during agreed US business hours. Most of the work is asynchronous, but you need to be reachable during overlap hours for quick questions and task handoffs.



Requirements

Minimum 2 years of experience as a Virtual Assistant or in a digital marketing support role

Excellent written English, verifiable through a short test task during hiring

Reliable high-speed internet with backup option

Comfortable using Google Workspace tools daily

Experience with WordPress or any website CMS

Ability to follow written SOPs precisely

Available for a minimum of 20 hours per week with potential to grow to full time



Nice to Have (Not Required)

Prior experience with SEO, GEO, or AI search tools

Experience with Canva for document production

Familiarity with Google Business Profile management

Experience at a marketing agency or with multiple clients simultaneously



What We Offer

Part-time to start (20 hours per week) with a clear path to full-time as client volume grows

Fully remote, asynchronous-friendly work environment

Direct access to the firm owner for questions and feedback

Long-term position with a growing company in an emerging and in-demand skill set

Stable recurring work with no project gaps, built on monthly client retainers





How to Apply

Send your application to 
] with the subject line: Kolab GEO VA Application

Include the following:



A short paragraph (3 to 5 sentences) in your own words explaining what GEO or AI search visibility means to you. Do not copy a definition from the internet. We want to hear how you understand it.

Your resume or a summary of your relevant experience.

title: TikTok Carousel Content Assistant / AI Image & Canva Designer
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented creative assistant to help turn short genre fiction stories into TikTok carousel posts.



You will receive a Google Doc containing a completed story. Your job will be to use AI tools and Canva to create a 10-slide TikTok carousel based on the story. You will need to create a 10-slide TikTok carousel three times a week. Your 30 slides must be turned in by Friday close of business.



This role is best for someone who understands visual storytelling, emotional hooks, TikTok-style content, and clean Canva design.



Responsibilities:



Use ChatGPT or similar AI tools to scan provided stories and then generate short text for a 10-slide TikTok carousel

Make sure each slide has a strong hook, emotional progression, and clear story flow

Use ChatGPT Images, Midjourney, or similar AI image tools to generate images for each slide

Make sure the images are consistent in style, character appearance, tone, and mood

Use Canva (the free versions is fine) to overlay the slide text onto the images

Create a polished final 10-slide carousel ready to post on TikTok

Send the finished Canva files / exported image slides for review

Revise slides when needed based on feedback



You should be good at:



Using ChatGPT or similar AI writing tools

Using AI image generation tools

Canva design (basic design / free Canva version)

Creating TikTok-style visual content

Understanding story structure and emotional pacing

Following instructions closely

Keeping characters and visuals consistent across multiple images

Writing short, engaging text that fits naturally on a slide. (One or two brief sentences per slide.)



Important:



This is not a traditional writing-only role. You will be using AI tools to help generate the carousel text and images. Your main value will be your ability to guide the AI, choose the best outputs, fix weak results, keep the story coherent, and make the final slides look professional.



Ideal candidate:



Has experience with Canva

Has used ChatGPT, Midjourney, ChatGPT Images, or other AI tools

Understands TikTok, Instagram carousels, or social media storytelling

Includes the phrase 'balut beats bologna' in their application so we know they read the full job post.

Has strong attention to detail

Can follow a repeatable process

Can make simple but attractive designs

Is comfortable working with genre fiction, including romance, drama, thriller, horror, or sci-fi stories



Sample Task:



For the application, please send a short sample showing how you would turn a story into a 10-slide TikTok carousel.



You do not need to create all 10 images for the application. Please provide:



A 10-slide text outline for a fictional story carousel. (Can be any story, even one you make up on the spot right now. One to two sentences per slide.)

One sample AI-generated image or Canva slide

A short explanation of which AI tools you used



Alternatively, please direct me to any social media carousels or images you have already produced. If your carousels are on TikTok it's a plus, but not required.



To Apply:



Please answer the following:



What AI writing tools have you used?

What AI image tools have you used?

How experienced are you with Canva?

Have you created TikTok, Instagram, or
 carousel content before? (If not already providing examples.)

Please link to any sample designs or social media content you have created.

Are you comfortable doing a paid trial task?



Note: We believe in responsible autonomy and treat everyone as an adult. This means you will be treated with respect and not micromanaged. We do not request that any software be installed on your computer to track hours or activity or anything of this nature. We also don't believe in time sheets, or anything like that. As long as you submit an original, plagiarism-free work we are 100% happy.



When you first start this endeavor, it will likely take you close to 30 hours to complete each week. After two months, most of our tea
mbers can successfully create the entire weeks' slides in 10 hours. (I'm listing the job as 20 hours a week, but there's almost no way you'll be spending that much time on it after the first month.)



Thank you and we look forward to hearing from qualified applicants soon.

description:
# Job Title



**Content & Community Growth Manager (Remote)**



### About Us



We are building a fast-growing online financial education and copy trading community. Our mission is to help ordinary people learn how to build an additional income through copy trading, supported by free education, genuine guidance and a welcoming community.



We're looking for someone creative, proactive and obsessed with creating engaging content that generates conversations and leads.



This isn't a traditional social media management role. We want someone who understands how to turn content into enquiries and enquiries into community members.



---



## Your Role



You'll work directly with the founder to build our online presence across Instagram,
, TikTok and other relevant platforms.



Your job is simple:



**Create content that gets people talking, messaging us and joining our community.**



---



## Responsibilities



* Edit engaging short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

* Turn one piece of content into multiple posts across different platforms

* Design attractive Canva graphics and carousel posts

* Write captions that encourage engagement and enquiries

* Create Instagram and
 Stories daily

* Research current trends and content ideas

* Repurpose podcasts, voice notes and videos into multiple content formats

* Schedule all content using Meta Business Suite or similar tools

* Respond to comments and messages professionally

* Help manage our online community

* Keep our CRM updated with new leads

* Track weekly performance and suggest improvements

* Bring fresh ideas—we're looking for someone who enjoys testing new approaches



---



## Essential Skills



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong Canva skills

* Excellent CapCut (or similar video editing) experience

* Experience creating viral or high-engagement social media content

* Understanding of Instagram,
 and TikTok algorithms

* Strong copywriting ability

* Organised and able to work independently

* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve productivity

* Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely



---



## Bonus Skills



Experience with any of the following would be a huge advantage:



* GoHighLevel

* WhatsApp Business

* CRM management

*
 marketing

* ManyChat

* Meta Ads

* Basic graphic design

* Copy trading, investing or financial education (not essential—we can teach this)



---



## What Success Looks Like



You won't be measured on follower numbers.



You'll be measured on:



* Quality content produced

* Consistency

* Engagement

* Qualified enquiries

* WhatsApp conversations started

* Leads generated

* Community growth



---

Initially:



20 hours per week



With the opportunity to move to full-time as the business grows.



---



## Salary



Please include:



* Your hourly rate (USD or GBP)

* Your availability

* Your time zone



We're happy to pay more for exceptional talent who can demonstrate results.



---



## To Apply



Please send us:



* Your CV

* Portfolio or examples of social media accounts you've managed

* Examples of videos you've edited

* A Canva design you've created

* Your favourite social media account and why you think it performs well

* A short video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself

**If you were given a brand-new Instagram account today with zero followers and a goal of generating 100 qualified leads in 90 days, what would your strategy be?**



We care much more about your thinking than perfect answers.

title: Brand & Content Creator (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health and improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain and discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain and distress others have to endure.



We’re seeking a full-time Brand and Content Creator to lead the creative direction of our brand across packaging, offline marketing, and digital platforms. This role is ideal for a strategic, hands-on creative who can own both design and content production, from ideation to execution, while supporting our expansion across Southeast Asia and global markets.



As a key member of the team, you'll be responsible for producing compelling visuals and content that reflect the heart of our brand and connect meaningfully with consumers, healthcare professionals, and distribution partners.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Brand Development & Creative Direction

*Lead development of visual identity for new and existing brands, including logos, packaging, brand guidelines, typography and brand story

*Propose and implement creative directions from Pantone color palettes to iconography, font systems and photography guidelines

*Develop pitch decks, sales presentations and brand kits for internal and external stakeholders

*Create visuals for promotions, campaigns, and trade shows for greater awareness and conversion



3. Content Creation & Copywriting

*Collaborate with the team to develop content ideas and messaging for various platforms (digital ads, social media, web,
)

*Write and edit marketing copy as needed, including taglines, brand messaging, product descriptions, and promotional materials

*Contribute to storytelling, campaign ideation, consumer education initiatives, and customer loyalty initiatives



4. Digital & Multimedia Content

*Produce digital assets for ecommerce platforms, social media ads, newsletters, and display ads (Google Ads Meta, TikTok)

*Edit videos and animations for campaigns, tutorials, events, and educational content using tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects

*Repurpose content across multiple formats and languages when applicable



5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

*Work closely with marketing, sales, pharmacists and leadership to turn strategic goals into compelling creative output

*Participate in product launch discussions and brand development brainstorming sessions

*Coordinate with external freelancers or vendors as needed



6. Regional Support & Market Expansion

*Adapt assets for regional markets including Singapore, Malaysia, Mainland China & Hong Kong and future expansion areas

*Ensure consistency across regions while accounting for local cultural, language, market and regulatory differences

title: Webflow Developer
description:
uBloom builds premium websites for architects, builders, and developers. Our clients are ambitious and our standard is high, so the work has to be right.



We're looking for a full-time Webflow developer to join our team and work alongside our senior developer. You'll be on live, existing projects rather than building from scratch, which means going into work that's already underway and making it better: cleaner, faster, and properly finished.



You won't be building websites from Figma. This role focuses on improving, maintaining and expanding existing Webflow projects. You'll be comfortable jumping into established builds, understanding how they're structured and making changes without creating unnecessary technical debt.



The role



Find and fix bugs

Clean up and restructure class systems

Build and maintain CMS

Improve page speed

Get responsive right across every breakpoint, including mobile and tablet

Build animations and interactions with GSAP and custom JavaScript

Handle revisions, design adjustments, and deployment

Take ownership of your tasks and see them through properly



Requirements



Strong experience with Webflow

Experience with GSAP

Experience with JavaScript

Experience with Finsweet Attributes

Strong understanding of responsive development

Experience working with CMS Collections

Excellent attention to detail

Strong problem-solving skills

Ability to work independently and manage your own workload



Bonus Skills



Experience with Client-First

SEO Performance optimisation

Basic SEO knowledge



How to apply



Send through your best Webflow work, and tell us about a project you inherited and improved: what was wrong, and what you did.



Then record a short Loom (3 to 5 minutes) walking us through one of your Webflow projects with your screen shared. Open it up and show us how it's structured: the class system, the CMS, how you've handled responsive. Talk us through a problem you ran into and how you solved it.



We won't consider applications without a Loom. We'd rather see how you work than read about it, and a paid practical task is part of our process from there.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

title: Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job Description

We are looking for an Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media. This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative & Performance Strategy

*Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo
/whatsapp marketing)

*A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

*Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve



2. In-House Content Production & Execution 

*Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

*Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

-Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

-Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

*Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

*Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

*Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts



3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

*E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

*Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

*Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

*Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

*User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

*Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

*Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): 

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

*Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

-Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

*Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data



5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

*CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

- Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

-Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

-Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

*Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end
 & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

-Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

*Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

-Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted
 & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

*WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

*Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time



6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

*Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

*Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

*Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS



7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

*Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

*Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

*Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

*Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials

*Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment



Requirements:

-3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus)

-Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors

-Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential

-Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

-Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI)

-Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for
 & mobile marketing

-Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building

-Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software

-A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV

-Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

-Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production

-Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. Adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals

-Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

-Excellent communication, project management skills & the ability to work cross-functionally

title: Brand Partnerships Coordinator (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
BRAND PARTNERSHIPS COORDINATOR (Remote, Part-Time)



We are looking for a highly organized Brand Partnerships Coordinator to manage sponsorship outreach for a portfolio of branded video series distributed across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok.



You will work directly with the founder to execute outbound sponsorship campaigns, manage follow-ups, maintain our contact database, and keep partnership opportunities moving through the pipeline.



Much of your time will be spent researching brand contacts, verifying information, managing Google Sheets, sending outreach
s, and tracking follow-ups. Outreach templates are provided— your job is to customize them intelligently per brand and execute with precision.



This role is ideal for someone who is exceptionally detail-oriented, persistent, and takes pride in keeping things organized and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Sponsorship Outreach

- Execute outbound sponsorship campaigns using provided templates, customized per brand

- Research and verify contact information before outreach

- Send outreach
s on behalf of the business

- Manage follow-up sequences and ongoing conversations

- Coordinate introductory calls with prospective sponsors

- Help expand and maintain sponsor contact lists across multiple industries



Pipeline & Database Management

- Maintain a detailled Google Sheets database of contacts, outreach status, responses, and next steps

- Track all sponsor conversations and flag high-priority opportunities

- Ensure follow-ups are completed on schedule

- Keep records clean, current, and easy to hand off



Weekly Reporting

- Provide a brief weekly summary of outreach activity, responses, and meetings booked

- Surface anything that needs a decision or attention

- Join a short weekly planning call



---



YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

- Are exceptionally detail-oriented — you notice when a name is misspelled or a title is outdated

- Have excellent written English communication skills

- Are comfortable with high-volume outreach and disciplined follow-up

- Enjoy organizing information and maintaining accurate records

- Are proactive and resourceful when researching contacts

- Can manage many simultaneous conversations without losing track of details

- Work well independently and stay on top of repetitive tasks without needing hand-holding

- Have a genuine interest in media, YouTube, creators, or digital culture (a real plus)



---



BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in sponsorships, influencer marketing, PR, fundraising, recruiting, sales development, or similar outreach-heavy roles

- Comfort with Google Sheets and Google Workspace

- Familiarity with the brand partnership or creator economy landscape



---



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

- This is not a content creation role

- This is not a personal assistant role

- This is not a social media management role

- This is not a creative strategy role



---



COMPENSATION

- Hourly, part-time (approximately 15–25 hours/week)

- Performance bonuses tied to deals closed and pipeline milestones

- Strong potential to grow in both hours and responsibility over time



---



TO APPLY, PLEASE SUBMIT:

- A brief paragraph on your relevant experience and why you're interested

- Your hourly rate

- Your weekly availability

- A few sentences on a time you managed a large volume of information without making mistakes

- Share a cold outreach
 you've sent that got a response (feel free to anonymize any names)



Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a short paid skills assessment.

- Experience: At least 2+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or Virtual Assistant handling a mix of business and lifestyle tasks.

- CRM & Tech Stack Proficiency: Familiarity with Google Workspace, communication platforms (Slack, WhatsApp), scheduling tools, and CRM databases (HubSpot experience is highly preferred).

- Organizational Excellence: Exceptional time-management skills with the ability to prioritize personal/family requests alongside business deadlines.

- Communication & Discretion: Flawless written and verbal communication skills; high level of discretion, trustworthiness, and professionalism when handling personal family data and executive communications.

- Adaptability: Ability to work independently, take initiative, and problem-solve with minimal supervision. Fast learner who can adapt quickly to specific business tools and playbooks.

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist
description:
Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Compensation: Competitive base salary + performance incentives + sales bonuses, with high performers able to earn up to PHP 70,000 per month through bonus opportunities.

Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.

Leave: One week paid leave per year 



About the Client



Our client is Australia’s leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating strong long-term career opportunities for high-performing individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, sales-driven role focused on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires strong multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence managing time-sensitive situations.



High-performing tea
mbers who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have the opportunity to progress into leadership roles and eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations



Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-moving dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We’re Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum 2 years’ experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience working with Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or tea
ntoring experience



What’s in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives

- Clear progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work culture

- Long-term career growth opportunities for high performers

# Content Operations & Video Editor (AI-Friendly)



**Remote  | Part-Time (10–15 hours/week to start)**



## Help Us Build a Thought Leadership Brand That Helps Women Heal



Karibuni Counseling & Wellness is a boutique trauma therapy practice and growing thought leadership brand founded by Akinlana Burrowes, LCMHC.



We specialize in helping **high-achieving women of color** heal from workplace trauma, burnout, anxiety, perfectionism, and the lasting effects of trauma through trauma-informed therapy, EMDR Intensives, corporate wellness education, and thought leadership.



Our vision extends beyond the therapy room.



We're building a trusted platform that equips women, organizations, and leaders with meaningful conversations about healing, workplace wellbeing, sustainable high performance, and emotional health.



Everything we create is grounded in excellence, authenticity, compassion, and purpose.



We're looking for someone who wants to help bring that mission to life.

This is **NOT** a basic social media posting job.



We're looking for someone who loves storytelling, organization, and creating beautiful content that makes people stop scrolling because it genuinely resonates.



You'll work closely with our founder to transform one monthly content recording session into engaging, platform-specific content that is edited, organized, scheduled, and published across multiple social media channels.



You'll also collaborate with AI-powered workflows that help us plan content strategically while preserving the authentic voice of our founder.

• Founder-recorded videos

into engaging content for:



- Instagram

- Organizing video files and media libraries

- Maintaining our content calendar

- Scheduling content across multiple platforms

- Collaborating with AI-assisted captions and content plans

- Monitoring basic content performance and suggesting thoughtful improvements



---



# Required Skills



We're looking for someone who is:



? Experienced in storytelling through video

? Comfortable implementing AI-Enhanced Content Production 



? Brand Operations



? Comfortable using Canva



? A strong written English communicator



? Reliable with deadlines



? Able to work independently while communicating consistently



---



# Preferred Experience



We'd especially love someone who has experience creating content for:



- Therapists

- Coaches

- Consultants

- Educators

- Speakers

- Service-based businesses



Experience creating **culturally responsive content that authentically resonates with women of color and multicultural audiences is strongly preferred.**



An understanding of the lived experiences of high-achieving women: particularly Black women navigating workplace stress, burnout, leadership, and trauma...is a significant plus.



Additional experience with Metricool, Notion, LinkedIn thought leadership content, or AI-assisted creative workflows is highly valued.



---



# Our Content Style



Our content is:



- Warm

- Emotionally intelligent

- Thought-provoking

- Hope-filled

- Professional

- Premium without feeling corporate

- Authentic rather than performative



We are **not** trying to become viral influencers.



We are building a trusted authority brand.



Our goal is to create content that makes the right woman feel seen, understood, and hopeful; while positioning our founder as a trusted voice in workplace trauma, EMDR Intensives, and healing for high-achieving women.



---



# Topics You'll Help Bring to Life



Our content focuses on conversations such as:



- Is High Achievement a Trauma Response?

- Workplace Trauma & Burnout

- EMDR Intensives

- Trauma Healing

- High-Achieving Women

- Leadership & Emotional Wellbeing

- Corporate Wellness

- Thought Leadership

- AI & Modern Private Practice Systems



---



# Hours & Growth



This role begins at approximately **10–15 hours per week** with the expectation of growing alongside the company.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term relationship—not simply complete tasks.



As our brand expands, this role has the opportunity to grow in responsibility, creativity, and leadership.



---

Please send:

title: Meta Ads AI UGC Editor
description:
OVERVIEW

We are looking for a skilled VSL (Video Sales Letter) Editor who can craft long-form, high-converting video content for e-commerce and DTC brands. This is not a short-form or social media role — you will own the full VSL production pipeline, turning raw scripts, footage, and voiceovers into polished sales videos that drive measurable revenue outcomes.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

• VSL Production: Edit full-length VSLs (typically 5–30 minutes) from provided scripts, voiceovers, and b-roll footage — structured to maximise viewer retention and purchase intent.

• DR Structure & Flow: Apply proven Direct Response frameworks: strong hook and problem identification in the opening segment, benefit-stacking through the body, and a high-urgency close with clear CTA.

• Visual Storytelling: Build compelling visual narratives that support the sales script — using text overlays, callouts, product close-ups, testimonial segments, and supporting graphics to reinforce key selling points.

• Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals.

• Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data.

• Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and
 funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement.
